4	/**
5	 * Get all overdue invoices as of a given date.
6	 * @param {Array<object>} invoices - All invoices
7	 * @param {string} asOf - Cutoff date in YYYY-MM-DD format
8	 * @returns {Array<{ number: string, customerId: string, dueDate: string, daysOverdue: number, due: number }>} Overdue invoices, most overdue first
9	 */
10	export function overdueInvoices(invoices, asOf) {
11	  return invoices
12	    .filter((inv) => (inv.status === 'issued' || inv.status === 'partially_paid') && inv.dueDate && inv.dueDate < asOf)
13	    .map((inv) => ({
14	      number: inv.number,
15	      customerId: inv.customerId,
16	      dueDate: inv.dueDate,
17	      daysOverdue: daysBetween(inv.dueDate, asOf),
18	      due: balanceDue(inv),
19	    }))
20	    .sort((a, b) => b.daysOverdue - a.daysOverdue);
21	}

- Status filtering
